name: Telemetry attribution
sovereign_question: Which observed entity and instrumentation scope does a signal claim, under which exact identity and merge rules?

name: Telemetry schema and conventions
sovereign_question: Which editioned field vocabulary and directional transformation gives attributes their telemetry meaning?

name: Trace graph
sovereign_question: What span occurrences, parentage, links, events and statuses form one observed distributed execution graph?

name: Metric streams
sovereign_question: What exact stream identity, point kind, unit, temporality, aggregation and gap semantics apply to measurements?

name: Logs and event records
sovereign_question: What occurred or was observed, at which times, severity and body mapping, without promoting a record to domain fact?

name: Execution profiles
sovereign_question: What sampled stacks and resource-consumption values were captured under which format, period and stability contract?

name: Telemetry context propagation
sovereign_question: How are correlation context and baggage parsed, forwarded, restarted or removed across a trust boundary?

name: Observation reduction and loss
sovereign_question: What selection, filtering, aggregation or truncation changed an observation population, and what loss remains?

name: Cross-signal correlation
sovereign_question: Which evidence-bearing edges relate distinct telemetry occurrences without asserting causality or completeness?

name: Telemetry export delivery
sovereign_question: What exact batch was offered to which destination, and what delivery outcome, retry obligation or uncertainty followed?
